description: Khanary actions system — unified dispatch surface for programs, micronauts, agents, and commands. Actions are executable units: each maps a verb to a target executor (binary, route, µ, kernel, or script).

programs.description: JSON programs dispatched via kuhul_dispatch.json or kuhul-server /programs route

micronauts.description: µ fold-cycle invocations — each action maps to a phase hook in a µ program
micronauts.dispatcher: micronauts/registry.json → µ JSON file → phase_hook resolver

agents.description: SCO agent bus — sidecar agents (brain, openai_compatible, scxq2, quantum_bot, etc.)

commands.description: KXML command tokens — symbolic glyph-mapped operations dispatched through the KLSL pipeline

action_schema.target: string (executor path, µ name, agent name, opcode)

how_to_add_an_action.programs: add .json to programs/ root + entry to programs_dispatcher.json
how_to_add_an_action.micronauts: add phase_hook to µ definition + entry to actions.manifest.json
how_to_add_an_action.agents: add agent.json to sco/agents/ + register in sco/registry.json
how_to_add_an_action.commands: add opcode to programs/opcode.table.json + HLSL/WGSL kernel via kxc_compile.ps1

stack_position: user/program/agent → actions dispatcher → [programs bus | µ phase hook | SCO agent | kxc opcode] → executor
